title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Ask how it felt
hook: Have you ever asked your players how practice felt?
intro: You rarely hear what the kids think of it.
statement: Kids will tell you what works if you ask.
q1: Do you ask the team for quick feedback —
q2: or read their energy and adjust on your own?
q3: What would they change if they could?
t1: Every coach is different. But practice gets better
t2: when kids get a say in it.
cta: Coaches — do you ask for feedback?
ctaLines: Thumbs up or down. Favorite drill. One change.
ctaPrompt: Share your feedback habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Have you ever asked your players how practice felt?
You plan every practice. You rarely hear what the kids think of it.
Kids will tell you what works if you ask.
Ask for feedback or read the room. Every team is different.
Do you ask for feedback? Share your habit in the comments.
